notes.title: Entering TGS 2025
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, this is Fukudanuki!
Today I went to the TGS venue to set up the booth for [i]Beautiful Life Show[/i]![/p][p]With the setup safely finished, we’re now ready for two Business Days starting tomorrow, followed by the General Days from Saturday onward![/p][p]The iGi/Sofu booth (10-C09), where you can try out [i]Beautiful Life Show[/i], is located in Hall 10. Once you find the Kodansha Game Lab booth, just head straight across the hall—our booth is right in front of Room6’s, on the left-hand side.[/p][p]The main halls are as lively as ever this year, but we hope you’ll also visit the Indie Corner to discover the next generation of hit titles. See you there![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258763/a6d720d3ddf1cc7b6bfbe5207d878c5495b400f1.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45258763/10020aa09c8cec82b2a233eba9b0153c198ca7e6.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Nice to Meet You, Steam!
notes.content: [h3][b]■Introduction[/b][/h3][p]Nice to Meet You, Steam![/p][p]Hello everyone! I’m [b]Fukudanuki[/b], the developer of [b]Beautiful Life Show[/b].[/p][p]Thank you so much for supporting [b]Beautiful Life Show[/b]![/p][p]Up until now, we’ve mainly been sharing development updates on social media like X (formerly Twitter) for our Japanese audience,[/p][p]but with our upcoming exhibition at Tokyo Game Show (TGS) from September 25–28,[/p][p]we’ve decided to start posting more regular development updates here as well.[/p][p]We’re still getting used to this platform,[/p][p]so we’d really appreciate your patience and warm support as we get started![/p][p]At this year’s TGS, we’ll be showcasing a playable demo at the iGi/Sofu booth in Halls 9–11 (International Exhibition Hall).[/p][p]If you’re planning to attend, please feel free to stop by and give it a try![/p]
